text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Mom, Dad, it's huge news! When I 
announced my Triple Tiara challenge, it 
caused a massive stir!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I want to get stronger like my senior, 
Oguri-san, who came from the regional 
tracks and made it big, so I don't let 
down everyone's expectations..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I was secretly doing extra training with 
that in mind, but I ended up making 
Trainer-san worry about me."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Still, hearin' 'em praise my runnin' and 
believin' I'd be all right really touched 
my heart. From now on, I'll take it step 
by step and do my best, no siree!"
